changed_dimension: Prompt message composition only: identical evidence_first instructions/output rules and context in one user message with QUESTION/CONTEXT labels.
adaptation: Retain original project JSON context/strict output schema; adopt taught single-user-message layout. No course data or answers enter the biomedical prompt.
hypothesis: The small local model may answer labeled QUESTION more reliably than the current serialized question/passages request split from system instructions.
pilot_scope: Focused diagnosis: two answerable questions with all reference facts already retrieved, and one unsupported-premise question. Not all-slice quality proof; broad pilot and full development coverage still required.
acceptance: Both answerable cases must become fully supported/complete, the unanswerable case must abstain without unsupported premise, and no new critical errors may appear. Otherwise revise/reject; no promotion from three questions.
rejected_alternatives: Change prompt wording, model and layout simultaneously
Treat the prior old-code pilot as current selection evidence
Use reference answers in the model request
tradeoffs: Single-message composition follows the taught local example but gives less role separation to untrusted retrieved data
All source text remains explicitly untrusted in unchanged output rules
Any layout gain still requires broad question coverage and prompt-injection failure tests
heldout_exposure: Only named development questions; final inference not run and no guaranteed-unseen claim.
next_action: Keep the incumbent. Test an explicit complete-answer JSON shape and question-part instructions as a separate prompt candidate; continue checking reference availability separately. Do not broaden a zero-quality layout into full development inference.
regressions: DIR-02 loses the already supported patient-count fragment and becomes an unnecessary abstention
